messages:
tara-support: heads up — enterprise customer acme-inc reports repeated 429s starting ~09:12UTC, but their quota panel shows ~30% remaining. raising here to triage. details in ticket #7892.
paul-eng: thanks. can you paste the exact request id(s) and any gateway logs? also which plan/limit?
tara-support: plan: reserved-2, token_limit: 10M/day. one sample request id: req_0x9f3a2. i grabbed the gateway log: `enforcer: allowed=false code=429 quota_remain=3123456 customer=acme-inc trace=req_0x9f3a2`
kevin-sre: weird — enforcer says applied, but console ingestion shows no spikes for acme-inc at that time. pinging telemetry team. @mike-telemetry any hooks? :eyes:
mike-telemetry: looking. i see spikes at the enforcer side in traces service, but the metrics pipeline shows a gap for that tenant from 09:10–09:20. there's an ingestion relay (ingest-relay-v2) that recently rolled with gzip change.
tara-support: customer provided a curl repro — they say calls succeed then suddenly 429. sharing curl (sanitized):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
     -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \ 
     -d @payload.gz \ 
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
paul-eng: interesting — `Content-Encoding: gzip` was added in the recent relay roll. if the relay sets `x-tenant` header and also compresses body, our ingestion consumer might be mis-parsing headers and dropping events for compressed bodies that exceed chunk size. do we have any error logs from relay?
ingest-bot: ingest-relay-v2 reported: `WARN: dropped event due to header_parse_error; tenant_header=acme-inc; seq=1342; compressed=true` at 2024-11-18T09:12:03Z
mike-telemetry: confirmed. looks like a header parsing regression when `compressed=true && seq > 1024` causes the consumer to throw away batch without ack. that leads to enforcement acting (it has realtime counters) but the console pipelines (which rely on acked events) never get the tokens.
kevin-sre: ok root cause candidate = relay header parsing bug causing silent drops for larger compressed batches. mitigation? can we replay from relay dead-letter or enable passthrough?
paul-eng: short term: flip ingest-relay-v2 to fallback mode (disable compression) and restart, that should let downstream ack normal events. also we can un-stall console by replaying DLQ for acme-inc for window 09:10–09:20.
tara-support: i relayed to customer — doing a maintenance window to toggle fallback. can we pls prioritize DLQ replay for that tenant, and add a quick dashboard annotation so support knows enforcement vs console mismatch?
mike-telemetry: starting DLQ replay now for tenant=acme-inc, window=1723456720..1723457400. ETA ~6m. i'll also add an alert on header_parse_error > 0 for the relay.
kevin-sre: thanks. action items: 1) patch relay header parsing (paul) 2) DLQ replay (mike) 3) update incident note and notify account execs (tara). i'll join the call if needed. :thumbsup:
paul-eng: i'll cut a short patch and ship canary to relay-staging. logging will include the full header blob on parse failures (PII scrubbed).
tara-support: closing loop with customer — they want a timeline and confirmation when replay is complete. will post final update here. :pray:
mike-telemetry: replay finished, metrics backfilled for acme-inc, console now matches enforcement counts. i've pushed an annotation and a postmortem draft to /docs/incidents/7923.
tara-support: awesome, sending customer update now. thanks everyone! :rocket:
